title: Charging, found closer
description: NEARVOLT EV is a planned app to help electric car and bike riders in Andhra Pradesh find compatible charging, from public stations to participating private hosts.

title: How it works
description: How the planned NEARVOLT EV app is meant to work: tell it your vehicle, see compatible options, compare time and estimated cost, then plug in.

title: For drivers
description: The planned charging-discovery experience for EV drivers and riders: connector compatibility, availability details, estimated costs and fallback options.

title: For charging hosts
description: How eligible charging hosts could take part in NEARVOLT EV: describe your equipment, set availability and prices, and stay in control.

title: Safety and trust
description: Suitable equipment, property permission, connector compatibility, accurate information, privacy and transparent policies at NEARVOLT EV.

title: FAQ
description: Answers about the planned NEARVOLT EV platform: compatibility, availability, the app launch, hosting and public versus private charging.

title: Contact and early access
description: Register early-access interest as a driver or host, propose a partnership or send NEARVOLT EV a question.

title: Legal & credits
description: Pre-launch notice, third-party credits and licences for the NEARVOLT EV website.
